title: A rain festival with no rain: the Indian farmers bracing for a ‘super’ El Niño as monsoon arrives late

paragraphs.en: Kasturi Gamango and Pramila Sabar cannot contain their giggles as they explain one of the big attractions of the Raja festival, which they attended a few days earlier along with 20 other farmer families in Laxmipur, in Odisha’s Ganjam district.
paragraphs.zh: 卡图里·加曼戈（Kasturi Gamango）和普拉米拉·萨巴尔（Pramila Sabar）解释拉贾节的一大看点时忍不住咯咯笑。几天前，她们与奥里萨邦甘贾姆县拉克希米普尔的其他20户农民家庭一起参加了这个节日。

paragraphs.en: “We do no work for three days during the festival,” they say. “Our husbands cook and clean while we enjoy our free time.”
paragraphs.zh: “节日期间，我们连续三天不干活，”她们说。“我们的丈夫做饭打扫，而我们享受空闲时光。”

paragraphs.en: Raja is a vibrant, agrarian celebration in the richly forested eastern Indian state of Odisha that celebrates fertility, womanhood and Basumati, the Hindu goddess of the Earth. Traditionally, the three-day event is held from 14 to 16 June to mark the start of the rainy season and the beginning of sowing crops.
paragraphs.zh: 拉贾节是印度东部森林茂密的奥里萨邦一个充满活力的农耕庆典，庆祝丰收、女性气质和大地女神巴苏马蒂。按照传统，这一为期三天的活动于6月14日至16日举行，标志着雨季开始和播种开始。

paragraphs.en: But this year the fields remained untouched, and the skies clear. The monsoon did not arrive until the end of the month.
paragraphs.zh: 但今年田地仍无人耕种，天空依然晴朗。季风直到月底才到来。

paragraphs.en: Global experts have officially declared that this year would see the onset of a “super” El Niño , an extreme version of the weather cycle, and expect it to intensify rapidly from July to September.
paragraphs.zh: 全球专家已正式宣布，今年将迎来“超级”厄尔尼诺，即这一天气循环的极端版本，并预计它将在7月至9月迅速加剧。

paragraphs.en: In India, El Niño years are usually associated with a weak monsoon, delayed and uneven rainfall, dry spells and extreme temperatures, leading to agricultural droughts, increased energy use and water shortages as reservoirs are depleted.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度，厄尔尼诺年通常与季风偏弱、降雨延迟且不均、干旱期和极端高温联系在一起，进而导致农业干旱、能源消耗增加，以及水库枯竭引发的水资源短缺。

paragraphs.en: June ended with a 40% shortfall in rain and even with the excess rainfall this month, the effects of drought have not been mitigated. The state has faced at least 19 droughts over the past 50 years .
paragraphs.zh: 6月以降雨缺口40%告终，即使本月降雨过量，干旱的影响也并未得到缓解。过去50年里，该邦至少经历了19次干旱。

paragraphs.en: Despite the dry conditions and a lack of irrigation facilities, farmers in Laxmipur cautiously sowed seeds in their paddy fields in the last days of June, hoping it would rain in time for germination. Mangala Sabar, 45, remembers the 2023-24 El Niño years “when the transplanting attempts failed twice in each year, and we lost the entire crop”.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管气候干旱且缺乏灌溉设施，拉克希米普尔的农民还是在6月的最后几天小心翼翼地在稻田里播下种子，希望及时下雨以利于发芽。45岁的曼加拉·萨巴尔（Mangala Sabar）还记得2023-2024年的厄尔尼诺年，“那两年每年的插秧尝试都失败了两次，我们损失了全部收成”。
